kept.excerpt: Today, pilot zone operations began in the villages of Froun, Srifa, and Zawtar Al-Gharbiya in accordance with the Trilateral Framework and under the auspices of the Military Coordination Group for Lebanon. This milestone is a direct outcome of last week's discussions between Israel and Lebanon in Rome.
kept.publisher: U.S. Department of State, statement by spokesperson Tommy Pigott; reproduced by Public Technologies
kept.relevance: This official cutoff-day statement documents implementation of a negotiated security process in named southern Lebanese villages, without identifying Choukine as a pilot zone.

kept.excerpt: NNA: An Israeli drone strike targeted the entrance to Maifadoun, near Choukine.
kept.publisher: MTV Lebanon, citing Lebanon's National News Agency
kept.relevance: This recent location-specific report documents aerial activity near Choukine, which does not itself establish a qualifying ground entry.

kept.excerpt: The deal was supposed to begin with two “pilot zones” where the Israeli military is to turn over control to the Lebanese army, which would clear the areas of any Hezbollah presence. However, implementation on the ground had stalled ahead of this week’s talks.
kept.relevance: This report provides the diplomatic and implementation context for assessing whether existing Israeli ground operations might expand or give way to withdrawal before the deadline.

kept.excerpt: Another Israeli drone struck a pickup truck at around 6 am local time (0300GMT) as it was unloading garbage on the outskirts of the towns of Choukine and Kfar Dajjal in the Nabatieh district. The attack left two people injured.
kept.publisher: Anadolu Agency, citing Lebanon's National News Agency
kept.relevance: This dated report places an Israeli attack on Choukine's outskirts but explicitly describes a drone strike rather than troops entering the municipality.

kept.excerpt: Israeli troops have reached the towns of Zawtar al-Sharqiyah and Choukine on the outskirts of Nabatieh.
kept.relevance: This is a directly relevant pre-cutoff claim that troops reached Choukine, although its wording alone does not establish municipal boundaries, an entry time, or corroborating photo and video evidence.

kept.excerpt: According to reports on Saturday, Israeli troops have pushed beyond the towns of Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh and Mayfadoun and are now positioned on the outskirts of Choukine, whose residents were ordered to evacuate on Friday.
kept.relevance: This lower-confidence report provides a contemporaneous description of troops on Choukine's outskirts, making the distinction between approaching the town and entering its municipality material.

kept.excerpt: The IDF calls on residents to flee seven southern Lebanese localities ahead of strikes on Hezbollah. Residents of Mayfadoun, Choukine, Zebdine, Ansar, Zrariyeh, Mazra’at Kawthariyat ar Ruzz and Machghara are urged to flee north of the Zahrani River.
kept.publisher: The Times of Israel, reporting an IDF evacuation warning
kept.relevance: The military warning explicitly names Choukine as an intended operations area, but an evacuation order ahead of strikes does not prove physical ground entry.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-20 inclusive. Included only items with explicit publication dates on or before that date; the Anadolu update is also before the cutoff. Excluded prediction-market and betting pages, undated reference pages, later reporting, and pages updated after the cutoff. Evidence was verified from dated web_search extracts, some containing substantial article text. web_fetch failed because multiple fetch providers were registered; the requested agent-reach fallback returned RATE_LIMITED and was not retried. Full-page retrieval and independent visual verification were therefore unavailable. The May 31 Al Jazeera wording that troops 'reached' Choukine and the May 30 Press TV description of troops on its outskirts should be retained with their respective dates and limitations; neither is treated here as a resolution determination. No post-cutoff developments or market outcome are included.
